# incident.io — account brief

## Who
incident.io makes all-in-one incident management software, letting teams declare, run, and learn from incidents without leaving Slack ([incident.io](https://incident.io/)). Its GitHub org is incident-io, with 38 public repos and 520 followers ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io)).

## Production Expo signals
- An `eas.json` file is present in the incident-io/on-call-app repo ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- The app runs react-native 0.74.3 ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows are configured in the repo ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- An open issue reports "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214))
- An open tracking issue covers upgrading to Expo SDK 53 ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198))
- The On-call app has 3,100 App Store ratings ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777))

## Why now
The repo was last pushed on 2026-08-19 ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)). The team shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). An EAS build failure on iOS is currently open ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)).

## Suggested opener
I saw the open issue about EAS builds failing on iOS since the Xcode 16 image update ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)). You are also tracking an upgrade to Expo SDK 53 while shipping to the App Store at a steady clip, 5 releases in the last 90 days ([github.com](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198), [apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). Is the Xcode image pin blocking your release pipeline right now, or have you found a workaround while the SDK 53 upgrade lands?
